---
name: Syntax or feature proposal
about: Suggest new syntax, a better keyword, or a new feature
title: "Proposal: "
labels: proposal
---

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe a real program you wanted to write, and what got in the way.

**What would it look like?**

```noodle

```

**Could a beginner understand it?** How do you know? For example, did you show it to someone new to programming?

**Can existing Noodle already do this?** If so, why isn't that good enough?

**Could this line ever mean two different things?** Noodle never guesses, so every line must have exactly one meaning.

The questions a full proposal (a NEP) has to answer are listed in [MISSION.md §17](https://github.com/noesisai3d/Noodle-programming-language-/blob/main/MISSION.md).
